books.name: Core holding
books.thesis: 24 names, market-cap weighted, no single-name cap (until 2026-10-12: no name above 40%) — holding the market.

books.name: Core holding, 40% cap (control)
books.thesis: The previous core rule, kept running as the control for removing the cap.

books.name: Equal weight + volatility target
books.thesis: The same panel equal-weighted, with exposure scaled to a volatility target.

books.name: Momentum tilt (weekly)
books.thesis: Overweights names with strong trends near their 52-week highs, inside the panel.

books.name: Momentum tilt (monthly)
books.thesis: The momentum tilt, rebalanced monthly.

books.name: CIS tilt
books.thesis: Overweights higher-CIS names inside the core holding.

books.name: Exposure timing (0.7–1.3x)
books.thesis: The core holding scaled between 0.7x and 1.3x by market state; never short.

books.name: Add-to-winners overlay (0.7–1.3x)
books.thesis: The core scaled up only while it is already making money - one step per new high, steps removed on a 20-day low - and cut to 0.7x below its long-term trend; never short.

books.name: Regime-match overlay (0–1.3x)
books.thesis: The core scaled by how closely today's market resembles past phases (0, 0.5, 1 or 1.3x).

books.name: Regime-match overlay, cuts only below trend
books.thesis: The same overlay, but it may only cut exposure while large caps sit below their 200-day average.

books.name: Exposure timing v1 (control)
books.thesis: The same timing rule on the previous 40%-capped core, kept as the control.

books.name: Portfolio layer (0–1x)
books.thesis: Exposure between 0 and 1 by market-state flags; can sit in cash.

books.name: Portfolio layer v2 (control)
books.thesis: The same exposure rule on the previous 40%-capped core, kept as the control.

books.name: Tokenization infrastructure tilt
books.thesis: A 25% tilt toward names carrying traditional assets on-chain.

books.name: Four-coin rule-based sizing
books.thesis: Four liquid coins held spot, position size set by rule.

books.name: Four-coin discretionary sizing
books.thesis: The same four coins, with discretionary size adjustments.

books.name: Funding-rate long/short
books.thesis: Long/short on funding-rate and positioning structure.
books.note: frozen — no new rows since 2026-10-20, record kept

books.name: Multi-strategy long/short
books.thesis: A long/short book built to scale.
books.note: frozen — no new rows since 2026-10-20, record kept

books.name: Combined long/short
books.thesis: Several long/short sleeves combined.
books.note: frozen — no new rows since 2026-10-20, record kept

books.name: Event-driven
books.thesis: Positions taken around identified events.
books.note: frozen — no new rows since 2026-10-20, record kept

books.name: Fusion long/short
books.thesis: Several sleeves fused into one long/short book.
books.note: frozen — no new rows since 2026-10-20, record kept

books.name: Two-layer book
books.thesis: A core-plus-overlay book; inactive while its core is replaced.

reading: Paper records and point-in-time replays, not live-traded P&L. The combined figures describe what the selected books did over the shown window; they are not forecasts and not investment advice. Returns are annualised only over a full year of shared record; shorter windows show the period return.
